__doc: Shared wizard foundation (WizardShell / FieldRenderer / GenericStepRenderer) + customFields/* components. Reused by both the Analyze and Content Pipeline wizards.

executionPreview.intro: When you click Run, the system will automatically process the following flow:
executionPreview.bgHint: The task runs asynchronously in the background — you can track its progress under "All Tasks".

reviseSteps.round1Desc: Prioritize structure, missing modules, Citation Alignment, and platform-fit blockers.
reviseSteps.recheckDesc: Run Quality Gate again to confirm whether blockers remain after revision.
reviseSteps.round2Desc: If needed, clean up incomplete sentences, duplicate FAQ, duplicate Conclusion, and brand density.
reviseSteps.recheck2Desc: Run Quality Gate again after the second revision; the final result is based on this recheck.

ai_discover.label: Let AI discover
ai_discover.description: AI recommends based on your data

modeGatePicker.aiAnalyzing: AI is analyzing your data to pick the topics and prompts that need the most optimization...
modeGatePicker.aiFailedFallback: You can switch back to "I'll decide" and configure manually, or pick "Let AI discover" again to retry.
modeGatePicker.aiEmptyHint: Configure prompts on the Prompts page first and wait for the Analyzer to finish, then come back to use AI mode.
modeGatePicker.aiAutofilled: Later steps have been auto-filled — adjust as needed.

p0.title: P0 · Web Search + Search Grounding
p0.description: Use Reddit URLs, subreddits, and keywords for limited discovery. This is the first production path.

p1.title: P1 · Reddit API
p1.description: Read posts, comments, and subreddit context through the official Reddit API.

placeholders.urls: One Reddit post or search-result URL per line
placeholders.keywords: e.g. AI promo video tool, product video maker

redditDiscovery.hint: Discover results are passed into strategy and content generation to shape community questions, objections, competitor signals, and posting risks.

source.title: P0 · Official Website URLs + Search Grounding
source.description: Read official website article pages and turn them into SEO/AEO content-gap insights for official-site article generation.

placeholders.urls: One official website article URL per line

officialWebsiteDiscovery.hint: Discover results are passed into strategy and content generation to fill official-site gaps, strengthen brand extractability, expand use cases, and improve brand-friendly FAQ coverage.

citationAnalysis.title: Citation Analysis preflight
citationAnalysis.description: Run Citation Analysis before generation so you can review cited pages, brand mention triage, and the grounded writing brief.
citationAnalysis.disabled: Citation Analysis is disabled for this template.
citationAnalysis.fetchHint: Fetch page title, meta, canonical URL, and readable body when available.
citationAnalysis.queryPlaceholder: Optional prompt, topic, or query override. Leave blank to use the selected prompts and topics.
citationAnalysis.runHint: The result will be injected into strategy generation and final content generation.
citationAnalysis.learnableStrengths: Why AI likely cites these sources
citationAnalysis.learnableStrengthsDesc: Reusable source advantages from already-cited pages: structure, evidence density, question framing, and extractable answer patterns.
citationAnalysis.visibilityGaps: Gaps to fill for customer GEO visibility
citationAnalysis.visibilityGapsDesc: Missing, incomplete, or unfavorable brand coverage that the generated content should fill conservatively.

subredditTargeting.title: Subreddit Targeting
subredditTargeting.description: Choose which Reddit communities this piece should target. AI Recommend only discovers candidates; rules are verified in the next step through deterministic fetch.
subredditTargeting.redditApiPending: Reddit API requires approved Reddit Data API access and configured Client ID / Client Secret. Use AI Recommend or Manual Input while approval is pending.
subredditTargeting.keywordsPlaceholder: e.g. robot vacuum pet hair, hardwood floors, smart home
subredditTargeting.hint: The result feeds Reddit Discovery for rules, about metadata, and discussion evidence.
subredditTargeting.stale: Upstream inputs changed. Regenerate and confirm subreddit targets.

errors.noCandidates: No usable subreddit candidates were generated. Adjust the keywords or use manual input.

redditResearchDiscovery.title: Reddit Discovery
redditResearchDiscovery.description: Fetch community rules, about metadata, and discussion evidence for confirmed subreddits. Rules must come from deterministic sources, not model-written text.
redditResearchDiscovery.blocked: Complete Subreddit Targeting and confirm at least one subreddit first.
redditResearchDiscovery.hint: If rules cannot be verified, the system marks them unavailable and requires manual review or a confirmed skip.
redditResearchDiscovery.noRules: No verified rules were fetched. Review this community manually before continuing.
redditResearchDiscovery.reviewRequired: Some communities have unverified rules. Paste reviewed rules or confirm skip.
redditResearchDiscovery.manualRulesPlaceholder: Paste manually reviewed community rules, one per line.
redditResearchDiscovery.skipRules: I reviewed this community and confirm continuing without rules for this run.
redditResearchDiscovery.stale: Subreddit, prompt, topic, or Citation inputs changed. Run Reddit Discovery again.

promptArtifactPreparation.title: Artifact Preparation
promptArtifactPreparation.description: Compress Reddit Research and strategy into final-prompt artifacts the generator can reuse directly.
promptArtifactPreparation.rulesBlocked: Reddit Discovery still has unconfirmed community rules. Resolve them before generating artifacts.
promptArtifactPreparation.hint: Confirmed artifacts are passed into final generation; the backend will not regenerate them.
promptArtifactPreparation.stale: Upstream inputs changed. Regenerate or reconfirm edited artifacts.
